entries.name: OpenHands Software Agent SDK
entries.ratified_version_line: 1.x current stable reference line — latest v1.42.1 (2026-08-12); the 1.24.x research anchor is superseded (VERSION CORRECTION applied to registry)

entries.name: Daytona
entries.ratified_version_line: 0.190.x reference pin = the final open-source line (0.190.0/0.190.1, 2026-06-23)
entries.license: AGPL-3.0 — verified from the official raw LICENSE at tag v0.190.0 (network copyleft). External provider/API usage only; VibeFlow must never incorporate, vendor or fork Daytona source into the codebase.
entries.official_source_checked: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona (repository banner + raw v0.190.0/LICENSE) ; pkg.go.dev/module license corroboration
entries.ownership_boundary: Daytona is a workspace implementation/provider behind the adapter; VibeFlow retains WorkspaceBinding authority, capability certification and reconciliation semantics.
entries.notes: FINDING 1 (maintenance): upstream OSS repository is explicitly unmaintained since June 2026 ('core development has moved to a private codebase'; no further OSS releases). The operated Daytona service continues. FINDING 2 (license): AGPL-3.0 triggers explicit review under LICENSE_POLICY; usage remains architecturally supportable because integration is external-API-only behind a certifying adapter. Phase-11 workspace certification must certify the operated service, not the frozen repository. Decision preserved (not silently replaced); no ADR required because the approved architecture (Daytona/E2B/BYOW behind certified adapters) is unchanged.
